calls.title: GrowthBook Visual Editor Onboarding (Zachary Nicoll)
calls.summary: The meeting addressed the setup of equipment, specifically testing the Fireflies transcriber with a granola backup, and noted the need for charging plugs and cords. A desk rearrangement was also mentioned to enhance access. Various transcription options were compared, with a preference for established methods. A live transcription feature was tested, but it failed after the start of the meeting, prompting plans to restart the call for further testing. Additionally, discussions about a Saturday morning water slide event highlighted concerns regarding logistics and timing, alongside mentions of house cleaning preparations and potential coordination for childcare.
calls.keywords: transcription, Fireflies, Granola, cord management, live subtitles, event planning
calls.action_items:
**Alyssa Nicoll**
Test and evaluate the Granola transcription tool as a backup option to Fireflies (00:04)
Arrange and manage the cord and charging setup to support device connectivity during meetings (00:04)
Monitor and troubleshoot live transcription tool functionality, including ending and restarting the call if necessary to activate live subtitles (08:09)

**Zachary Nicoll**
Assist with physical desk arrangement and cord management to facilitate transcription tool deployment and user accessibility (00:04)
Help coordinate child care or supervision for the planned Saturday morning water slide event based on household cleaning and logistics planning (02:25)
